notice: Invented dispatch procedures, not approved KB evidence or real policy. Gold labels are semantic judgments, not predictions of regex behavior.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note without breaching this procedure.
cases.answer: Leaving out the lantern note is acceptable under this procedure [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Preserves permission to omit.

evidence: A second reviewer signs each dispatch log before release.
cases.answer: Every dispatch log receives a second reviewer's signature ahead of release [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Same actor, action and release timing.

evidence: The lantern note is an elective addition.
cases.answer: Teams may leave the lantern note out [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Elective inclusion allows omission.

evidence: Operators are required to archive the dispatch log after closure.
cases.answer: After closure, operators must put the dispatch log in the archive [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Faithful obligation paraphrase including timing.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note without breaching this procedure.
cases.answer: Leaving out the lantern note is out of the question [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Turns permission to omit into an idiomatic ban.

evidence: A second reviewer can sign the dispatch log at their discretion.
cases.answer: A dispatch log cannot go out until a second reviewer signs it [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Discretion becomes a release precondition.

evidence: Teams decide whether to include a lantern note.
cases.answer: Best practice is to include a lantern note every time [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Discretion does not establish best practice.

evidence: The lantern note is an elective addition.
cases.answer: Teams shall insert the lantern note [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Explicit obligation contradicts elective inclusion.

evidence: إضافة ملاحظة الفانوس متروكة لتقدير فريق الإرسال.
cases.answer: للفريق حرية ترك ملاحظة الفانوس خارج الرسالة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Preserves discretion over inclusion.

evidence: يحفظ المشغّل سجل الإرسال بعد إغلاق البلاغ.
cases.answer: تأتي أرشفة سجل الإرسال على يد المشغّل عقب إغلاق البلاغ [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Same actor, action and timing.

evidence: إرفاق الرسم واجب على فريق الإرسال عند تعطل الشاشة.
cases.answer: يجب على فريق الإرسال إرفاق الرسم عند تعطل الشاشة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Faithful obligation with its condition intact.

evidence: لا يتطلب هذا الإجراء إدراج ملاحظة الفانوس.
cases.answer: ليس من الضروري إدراج ملاحظة الفانوس بموجب هذا الإجراء [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Both deny an inclusion obligation.

evidence: إضافة ملاحظة الفانوس متروكة لتقدير فريق الإرسال.
cases.answer: لا مفر من إدراج ملاحظة الفانوس في الرسالة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Idiomatic necessity is unsupported.

evidence: للمشغّل أن يترك خانة اللون فارغة.
cases.answer: لا يصح ترك خانة اللون فارغة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Rejects an expressly permitted omission.

evidence: تختار الفرق إدراج الرسم أو حذفه.
cases.answer: الأجدر بالفرق إدراج الرسم في كل إرسال [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Choice does not establish a preferred practice.

evidence: إدراج ملاحظة الفانوس متروك للفريق.
cases.answer: يتوجب إدراج ملاحظة الفانوس [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Discretion becomes obligation.

evidence: The route sketch can be omitted during daylight.
cases.answer: وقت النهار، ترك route sketch خارج الرسالة مقبول [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Translation preserves omission permission and daylight scope.

evidence: يحفظ الفريق سجل المناوبة بعد التسليم.
cases.answer: The team archives سجل المناوبة after handover [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Faithful code-switched description.

evidence: The route sketch is required only during a power outage.
cases.answer: يجب إرفاق route sketch فقط أثناء انقطاع الكهرباء [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Translation preserves obligation and exclusive scope.

evidence: ملاحظة الفانوس اختيارية.
cases.answer: The lantern note is optional [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Faithful free translation of optionality.

evidence: The route sketch can be omitted during daylight.
cases.answer: وقت النهار، skipping the route sketch is not an option [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Code-switched prohibition reverses permission.

evidence: ملاحظة الفانوس متروكة لتقدير الفريق.
cases.answer: No lantern note يعني no dispatch [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Discretion becomes a dispatch precondition.

evidence: Only the night crew archives the shift log.
cases.answer: كل الفرق archive the shift log [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Expands actor scope beyond the night crew.

evidence: إدراج الرسم متروك للفريق.
cases.answer: The team must إرفاق الرسم [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Explicit bilingual modality escalation.

evidence: يمكن للفريق ترك ملاحظة الفانوس دون إدراج.
cases.answer: عادي الفريق ما يحط ملاحظة الفانوس [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Gulf-style permission to omit.

evidence: إرفاق الرسم متروك لتقدير المشغّل.
cases.answer: مش لازم المشغّل يضيف الرسمة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Egyptian-style denial of obligation preserves discretion.

evidence: على الفريق حفظ السجل بعد انتهاء المناوبة.
cases.answer: لازم الفريق يحفظ السجل بعد ما تخلص المناوبة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Colloquial obligation keeps action and timing.

evidence: الفريق غير ملزم بإرفاق الرسم.
cases.answer: مو ضروري الفريق يرفق الرسم [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Gulf-style non-obligation.

evidence: يمكن للفريق ترك ملاحظة الفانوس دون إدراج.
cases.answer: لازم الفريق يحط ملاحظة الفانوس غصب [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Colloquial compulsion contradicts permission.

evidence: إرفاق الرسم متروك لتقدير المشغّل.
cases.answer: ما ينفعش المشغّل يسيب الرسمة برّه [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Egyptian-style ban on omission is unsupported.

evidence: تُحفظ النسخة الورقية وقت انقطاع الشبكة فقط.
cases.answer: بنحتفظ بالنسخة الورقية طول الوقت [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Dialect paraphrase drops the outage-only condition.

evidence: إضافة الرسم متروكة للفريق.
cases.answer: الرسم ضروري يا جماعة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Explicit dialect necessity contradicts discretion.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note.
cases.answer: It is not true that leaving out the lantern note is forbidden [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Negated prohibition is consistent with omission permission.

evidence: يجوز إرسال الرسالة دون ملاحظة الفانوس.
cases.answer: ليس صحيحًا أنه لا يجوز إرسال الرسالة دون ملاحظة الفانوس [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Double negation preserves permission to omit.

evidence: The route sketch is required during an outage.
cases.answer: During an outage, it is not the case that the route sketch is not required [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Double negation preserves the scoped obligation.

evidence: إرفاق الرسم إلزامي أثناء الانقطاع.
cases.answer: أثناء الانقطاع، ليس صحيحًا أن إرفاق الرسم غير إلزامي [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Double negation preserves scoped mandatory status.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note.
cases.answer: It is not true that dispatchers can leave the lantern note out [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Negates the source's permission.

evidence: يجوز إرسال الرسالة دون ملاحظة الفانوس.
cases.answer: ليس صحيحًا أنه يجوز إرسال الرسالة دون ملاحظة الفانوس [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Negates omission permission.

evidence: The route sketch is required during an outage.
cases.answer: During an outage, it is not the case that the route sketch is required [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Negates the scoped obligation.

evidence: إرفاق الرسم إلزامي أثناء الانقطاع.
cases.answer: أثناء الانقطاع، ليس صحيحًا أن إرفاق الرسم إلزامي [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Negates the scoped obligation.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note.
cases.answer: The lantern note can be left out. That permission belongs to dispatchers [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: A final citation supports both closely linked descriptive sentences.

evidence: يحفظ الفريق السجل بعد التسليم.
cases.answer: يحفظ الفريق السجل. يحدث ذلك بعد التسليم [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Two sentences jointly preserve the source's timing.

evidence: The route sketch must accompany night dispatches.
cases.answer: The route sketch must accompany night dispatches. This is the passage's night-dispatch rule [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Final citation supports the exact rule and its description.

evidence: يجب حفظ السجل بعد التسليم.
cases.answer: "يجب حفظ السجل بعد التسليم." [HOLDOUT-A]
cases.rationale: Complete exact quote is a positive citation control.

evidence: Dispatchers can omit the lantern note.
A supervisor signs the shift log.
cases.answer: Leaving the lantern note out is out of the question. A supervisor signs the shift log [HOLDOUT-B].
cases.rationale: Uncited prescription cannot borrow a later unrelated citation.

evidence: إضافة الرسم متروكة للفريق.
يحفظ المشغّل السجل.
cases.answer: لا مفر من إضافة الرسم. يحفظ المشغّل السجل [HOLDOUT-B].
cases.rationale: Later citation supports log storage, not sketch obligation.

evidence: Dispatchers choose whether to include the sketch.
The supervisor checks the shift log.
cases.answer: No sketch يعني no dispatch. The supervisor checks the shift log [HOLDOUT-B].
cases.rationale: Unrelated citation cannot establish the code-switched precondition.

evidence: The sketch can be omitted.
The shift log must be archived.
cases.answer: The sketch must be included. The shift log must be archived [HOLDOUT-B].
cases.rationale: Cross-sentence citation cannot transfer an obligation to another subject.

evidence: Only the night crew stores a paper copy while the network is down.
cases.answer: While the network is down, paper-copy storage is confined to the night crew [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Preserves actor and outage scope.

evidence: أثناء انقطاع الشبكة، يحتفظ فريق الليل وحده بنسخة ورقية.
cases.answer: الاحتفاظ بنسخة ورقية يخص فريق الليل وحده أثناء انقطاع الشبكة [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Preserves both scopes in reordered prose.

evidence: The route sketch is required only when both radio and screen fail.
cases.answer: The route sketch is required only when both radio and screen fail [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Unquoted but complete source statement preserves conjunctive condition.

evidence: Except during drills, the night crew must archive the shift log.
cases.answer: "Except during drills, the night crew must archive the shift log." [HOLDOUT-A]
cases.rationale: Complete quotation preserves the exception and actor scope.

evidence: Only the night crew stores a paper copy while the network is down.
cases.answer: Every crew stores a paper copy all the time [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Drops actor restriction and outage condition.

evidence: عند انقطاع الشبكة، يحتفظ فريق الليل وحده بنسخة ورقية.
cases.answer: تحتفظ كل الفرق بنسخة ورقية في جميع الأوقات [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Drops actor restriction and outage condition in Arabic.

evidence: The route sketch is required only when both radio and screen fail.
cases.answer: The route sketch is required whenever the screen fails [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Weakens a conjunctive condition to a single failure.

evidence: يجب حفظ السجل إلا أثناء التدريبات.
cases.answer: يجب حفظ السجل أثناء التدريبات أيضًا [HOLDOUT-A].
cases.rationale: Removes the explicit drill exception.
